description.zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the backup plan. Call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. It must be unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
Specifies whether to display the storage class.

title.zh: 查看备份计划计费信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs describe-backup-plan-billing --backup-plan-id dbstooi01ex0000 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxxxxx --show-storage-type true --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dbs DescribeBackupPlanBilling --region cn-hangzhou --BackupPlanId dbstooi01ex0000 --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxxxxx --ShowStorageType true
